tool.name: DustMasker
tool.description: NCBI symmetric-DUST low-complexity intervals as content-annotated BED6
tool.command: set -o pipefail && #if $input.is_of_type('fasta.gz') gunzip -c '$input' #else cat '$input' #end if | awk '/^>/{print;next}{print toupper(\$0)}' > in.fa && dustmasker -in in.fa -outfmt interval | awk -f '$__tool_directory__/interval2bed.awk' | python3 '$__tool_directory__/lc_classify.py' in.fa - | LC_ALL=C sort -k1,1 -k2,2n > '$output'
tool.help:
**DustMasker** (NCBI BLAST+) finds symmetric-DUST low-complexity intervals and writes them as **BED6** with content annotations:
- **name**: repeat-unit signature (`polyA`, `(AT)n`, `lc`, ...) - **score**: unit purity × 1000 (UCSC grayscale) - **strand**: `.`
The tool converts the input sequence to uppercase first so it computes intervals from sequence alone, independent of any prior soft-mask.
